name: Palo Signature Warm Chocolate Soufflé with Vanilla Bean & Chocolate Anglaise
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse
whyItWorks: Baked to order from whipped egg whites, sugar, and dark cocoa—cloud-light, zero nuts, zero seeds, and 100% citrus-free (unlike the main dining room Grand Marnier soufflé).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order at the start of your meal; take 1–2 Lactaid tablets before pouring in the warm vanilla bean sauce and vanilla gelato.
watchOuts: Dairy cream in vanilla anglaise and gelato
